native-author-source.description: Rust supplied-text manuscript assembly and executable owner test for AUTH-001; not model authorship or full author-role parity.

node-module-protocol-adapter-source.description: Exact bounded Node Module Protocol planning, invocation, observation and cancellation implementation for MIG-002.

module-platform-registry-protocol-source.description: Exact Rust registry, lifecycle, canonical protocol, SDK reduction, contract conformance, and executable owner tests for MOD-004, MOD-005, and MOD-006.

control-plane-execution-source.description: Exact Rust execution request, filesystem verifier, deterministic runtime, and executable fail-closed owner tests for MOD-003 and CTL-005. Live-clock regressions cover wave fencing, final-use expiry and rollback of real SQLite results/lifecycle events; controlled clocks are test inputs, not production time attestation. Same-wave request handoffs now revalidate the original live clock/lease; exact regression requirements cover refusal before a second handoff and retained accounting without claiming physical cancellation or atomic process-start authority.

scientific-evidence-verifier-source.description: Exact Rust scientific-evidence capsule consistency, supplied artifact-set hash binding, implementation-identity separation, and assurance non-inflation checks. This bundle does not claim artifact-byte recomputation, scientific-result recomputation, verifier authentication, or external-attestation authentication.

legacy-compatibility-kernel-source.description: Exact Rust legacy stable-JSON, production Node profile, and Node-oracle differential owner tests for MIG-003.

cutover-retirement-source.description: Exact Rust durable cutover and immutable legacy-writer freeze verification with rollback, authority rejection, quiescence, and active-work owner tests for MIG-005 and MIG-006.

program-truth-history-source.description: Exact development-document DAG and canonical-history policy validator with executable governance owner tests for SYS-005. The canonical prospective subject is shared by all three existing lanes; typed module contracts remain hard gates while explanatory document shape is advisory.

native-business-binding-and-bundle-sourc.description: Native capability routing across library, durable service and process boundaries, with bounded content-addressed bundle decoding and negative parser tests. Existing ServiceExecutorV1 additionally fences unresolved prior dispatches across owner restart and changed plans using the same durable attempt records and directory lock; terminal reconciliation and physical resource settlement remain separate. Paired caches additionally require actual content-verified evidence bound to the exact start request; copied unrelated results, corrupt/missing evidence and self-rehashed malformed identity fields refuse new dispatch. Same-wave request handoffs now revalidate the original live clock/lease; exact regression requirements cover refusal before a second handoff and retained accounting without claiming physical cancellation or atomic process-start authority.

codex-product-dispatch-source.description: Authority-owned product operation descriptors now compose the existing durable Codex broker path. Exact source binds role, campaign/attempt, lease, workspace, prompt/manifest/schema, mutation and resource ceilings; explicit preflight, physical-release and postflight revalidation prevents input drift without rejecting legitimate post-execution workspace mutation. The descriptor digest is retained in prepared evidence and bounded journal scanning supports deterministic startup recovery. These tests prove repository-local source behavior only; installed daemon topology, real provider credentials, target-host qualification and live author/reviewer canaries remain external.
